item.title: Anthropic Launches Record IPO at Up to $1.4 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic is expected to go public on November 19 at a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, potentially the largest IPO in history. Wall Street is already building hype, with at least seven issuers preparing 11 single-stock leveraged ETFs, while Vanda Research projects roughly $250 million in net retail buying, double the SpaceX IPO record. The listing is seen as a key test for reviving confidence in the AI sector, though it also highlights the allocation gap between institutions and retail investors.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动史上最大 IPO 估值或达 1.4 万亿美元

Why it matters：万亿级估值 IPO 将直接检验 AI 板块的资本市场信心，是行业走向的关键风向标。

item.title: Suno Launches Visuals to Pair AI Music with Generated Video
item.description:
Suno has launched Visuals, a feature that generates up to 15-second video clips for its AI-made songs using H3 Move, a customized version of MiniMax's H3 video model. It supports lyric sync, lip sync and timeline extension across web, iOS and Android, with filters and embedded watermarks to address copyright risk.

原文标题：Suno 推出 Visuals 功能 为 AI 音乐生成配套视频

Why it matters：音乐生成平台向多模态内容生产延伸，且明确采用中国开源视频模型定制，具备产品与技术选型双重参考价值。

item.title: AgiBot Deploys Nearly 500 Humanoid Robots at Chimelong Park
item.description:
AgiBot partner Wang Chuang said at the APEC Finance Night that the embodied-AI theme park built with Chimelong has deployed nearly 500 robots across more than 100 roles since opening in September, targeting 1,000 units by year-end. He stressed that humanoid robots must deliver real work, not just walking and talking.

Why it matters：这是人形机器人从演示走向规模化岗位部署的少见量化案例，值得关注落地进展。

item.title: Google Gemini 4 Neon Model Leaks Alongside New Subscription Tier
item.description:
Developers spotted a gemini-4-neon identifier in the Gemini web app code, sitting alongside the already released Argon, Carbon and Hydrogen models, suggesting a fourth Gemini 4 variant is in preparation. The same code reveals a TIER_NEON subscription level marked as a Gemini Ultra variant tied to upsell logic, though Google has disclosed no parameters or capability details.

item.title: Energy-Based Reasoners Achieve 385x Inference Efficiency Gain
item.description:
Researchers introduce Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs), which learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and cast looped updates as gradient descent on that energy, using the energy value as a stopping signal. Across four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, EBRs match or beat prior recurrent reasoning models, reaching 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with 345x less inference compute and achieving state-of-the-art coverage of distinct valid solutions on multi-solution tasks.

原文标题：能量推理器实现 385 倍推理效率提升

Why it matters：以能量函数显式引导循环推理并给出停止信号，在硬推理基准上实现数量级推理算力节省，对推理架构研究有直接参考价值。

item.title: Amazon Signals Openness to External AI Shopping Agents
item.description:
Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said the company has not permanently closed the door on external AI shopping agents placing orders on its platform, provided they deliver a good consumer experience and a fair value exchange. Amazon blocked Meta's Muse and similar agents in September and is now in talks with each vendor while pushing its own Alexa for Shopping and Buy for Me tools.

item.title: Intel Launches New Layoff Round Affecting Global IT Division
item.description:
Intel has begun a new round of layoffs hitting its global IT division as part of CEO Lip-Bu Tan's ongoing restructuring, with headcount and affected teams undisclosed. Staffing has fallen to 81,100 by end-September from 85,100 at the end of 2025, underscoring sustained contraction amid manufacturing setbacks and eroding AI chip share.

item.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Tops 10M Daily Users With 100 Trillion Daily Tokens
item.description:
Tencent's Q3 2026 earnings reveal that WorkBuddy has surpassed 10 million daily active users and 100 trillion daily tokens, making it the highest-volume LLM-powered AI product in China. Since its March launch it has shipped over 100 major releases, with its enterprise edition reaching 50% of China's Fortune 500, while the Hunyuan Hy4 flash model hit 50 trillion tokens on its first day and topped OpenRouter's daily leaderboard.

原文标题：腾讯 WorkBuddy 日活破 1000 万 日均 Token 超 100 万亿

item.title: Nvidia Faces Securities Litigation Risk After Huang Resignation
item.description:
Nvidia has bought up to $950 million in D&O coverage for executives and directors but carries no corporate liability insurance for its own securities fraud exposure, meaning any successful suit would be paid from its cash reserves. At least two lawsuits have been filed since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and admitted infidelity, including a proposed securities fraud class action naming both the company and Huang.

原文标题：黄仁勋辞职引发英伟达证券诉讼风险

CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator said he is not worried that Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia will hurt its business, citing thousands of Nvidia engineers still working daily on deployments and data center buildouts. The remarks highlight how heavily neoclouds depend on Nvidia's supply chain and backing after debt-fueled AI infrastructure expansion.

item.title: Masayoshi Son Admits Missing Anthropic Was a Mistake
item.description:
SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son publicly conceded in Tokyo that skipping an early investment in Anthropic was a mistake, attributing it to a deliberate single-horse bet on OpenAI. He rejected bubble talk, saying AI is only beginning, and outlined SoftBank's four-pillar strategy across models, chips, data centers and physical AI, with Arm positioned to serve rival developers including Anthropic.

Why it matters：孙正义罕见复盘投资取舍，并给出软银 AI 四大支柱与平台化战略的明确表态，对判断头部资本流向有参考价值。

item.title: Talos Linux Launches Enterprise Tier with Compliance and Audit Support
item.description:
Sidero Labs has launched Talos Enterprise Linux, sharing the same codebase as the open-source edition while adding FIPS 140-3 compliance, security artifacts, CVE SLAs, indemnity and 24/7 support aimed at NIS2 and CRA audits. The open-source OS remains free under MPL-2.0, with no capabilities moved behind a paywall.

item.title: Nvidia Private Equity Holdings Surge to $65.5 Billion
item.description:
Nvidia's private-company equity holdings have climbed to $65.5 billion, up sharply from $22 billion in January, with $58 billion deployed across the first nine months of the fiscal year. The company has backed nearly 350 startups over three years and disclosed $118 billion in guarantees, including $105 billion backstopping OpenAI's Ohio data center project. With Jensen Huang no longer at the helm, interim CEO Colette Kress is expected to tighten startup investment and return excess free cash flow to shareholders.

原文标题：英伟达非上市股权投资飙升至 655 亿美元

Why it matters：英伟达股权投资规模与 OpenAI 数据中心兜底担保，直接反映 AI 算力生态的资本流向与潜在风险。

item.title: Rockchip RK1860 Edge AI Chip Packs 64 TOPS and 10GB On-Package DRAM
item.description:
Specifications for Rockchip's RK1860 edge AI co-processor have surfaced, featuring a 64 TOPS dense INT8 NPU, up to 10GB of integrated DRAM, a quad-core RISC-V CPU and four PCIe Gen3 lanes. Engineering samples are expected this quarter, positioning it as a highly integrated accelerator for edge inference.

item.title: Tesla Unveils Powercore Integrated Solid-State Electrical System for 2027
item.description:
Tesla has unveiled Powercore, a solid-state electrical system that consolidates medium-voltage transformers, inverters and solid-state breakers into a single cabinet, delivering up to 7.4 MW continuous output for storage, solar and AI data center projects. Supporting 800V-2000V DC and up to 34.5kV AC with 100-microsecond fault interruption, it is slated for U.S. production in 2027 with pricing undisclosed.

InclusionMed has launched as the world's first independent evaluation and analysis platform for healthcare AI, built by researchers from 29 institutions including Stanford, Harvard, Peking Union Medical College and Ant Group. Its first index covers five benchmarks and 1,034 tasks, comparing 22 models from 11 vendors, alongside an evaluation atlas and index.

item.title: Salesforce Caps Employee AI Token Spend at $1,000 Monthly
item.description:
Salesforce has begun assigning monthly AI token budgets by role after some employees spent thousands of dollars a month, with technical staff capped at $1,000 and non-technical staff at $100. A pilot team came in well under budget without hurting output, highlighting the broader corporate tension between AI adoption and cost control.

item.title: Microsoft Launches Copilot Today to Proactively Organize Workdays
item.description:
At Ignite 2026, Microsoft unveiled Copilot Today, shifting its AI assistant from reactive Q&A to proactive preparation. Integrated into the Copilot app and Outlook, it combines a personalized Today Brief morning digest with a continuously refreshing Today Feed that aggregates email, calendar, Teams chats and tasks. The feature is currently limited to a Frontier private preview, raising fresh privacy and attention concerns over broad workplace data access.

原文标题：微软推出 Copilot Today 主动整理全天工作

Why it matters：微软将 Copilot 从被动应答推向主动编排工作流，是智能体化办公助手的重要产品信号。

item.title: AI Chip Boom Lifts Korea Exports Toward $1 Trillion as Stock Slump Hits Demand
item.description:
South Korea is on track to join the $1 trillion export club on the back of memory-chip shipments from SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, yet the KOSPI has fallen more than 40% from its June peak, with AI-linked stocks leading the slide and pushing Q3 consumption into its first contraction in nearly two years. Semiconductors employ just 0.8% of the workforce, concentrating the boom's gains, while Seoul plans a KRW 162.3 trillion future-response fund and support for services as a second growth engine.

原文标题：AI 芯片拉动韩国出口破万亿美元 股市暴跌拖累内需

Why it matters：揭示 AI 算力繁荣与本土消费、就业分化之间的结构性张力，是观察 AI 资本周期外溢效应的关键样本。

item.title: Google AI Overviews Wipe Out 75% of Independent Site Traffic
item.description:
The operator of All About Berlin, a Berlin living guide running since 2017, reports that site traffic fell 70-75% after seven years of growth, as Google AI Overviews now answer queries using his content while pushing his link below ads and AI summaries. The case illustrates how generative search is systematically eroding the business model of independent content creators.

原文标题：谷歌 AI 概览致独立网站流量暴跌 75%

Why it matters：以具体流量数据揭示 AI 搜索对内容生态的真实冲击，是理解生成式 AI 产业外溢效应的典型样本。

item.title: CXMT Posts 89.53% Q3 Gross Margin as DRAM Shortage Persists
item.description:
CXMT said at its Q3 earnings briefing that the DRAM supply shortage will persist through the fourth quarter, and that it has begun negotiating long-term supply agreements with major customers to lock in demand. Q3 gross margin reached 89.53%, its debt-to-asset ratio fell to 36.34% from about 54% at the end of last year, and the company is advancing a 4F² architecture as its next-generation technology bet.

原文标题：长鑫科技 Q3 毛利率 89.53% 预计 DRAM 紧缺延续至四季度

Why it matters：国产 DRAM 龙头的产能、定价与债务结构变化，直接反映 AI 服务器与端侧存储需求的供需紧张程度。

item.title: TrendForce Forecasts NAND Price Drop in Q2 2027 as DRAM Rally Persists
item.description:
TrendForce unveiled its 2027 memory market outlook in Seoul, projecting that new NAND capacity will push flash prices down starting in Q2 2027, while general-purpose DRAM prices will not decline through end-2027 due to limited new capacity and HBM crowding out supply. The firm also expects HBM to rise from 23% to nearly 30% of DRAM wafer output at the three major memory makers, with HBM4 pricing climbing from $2.05 to $3-5.5 per Gb.

原文标题：TrendForce 预测 NAND 价格 2027Q2 转跌，DRAM 涨势延续至年底

Why it matters：存储价格走势直接决定 AI 算力与服务器成本，该预测给出了分季度的明确量化路径。

item.title: China's First Ascend 950DT Token Export Compute Cluster Goes Live in Shantou
item.description:
China's first Ascend 950DT-based token-export compute cluster has gone live in Shantou, jointly built by Huawei, China Telecom Shantou and Tianyima. Leveraging the Shantou international submarine cable landing station, it performs inference and token generation domestically under a compute-out-data-stays policy and delivers tokens to overseas markets such as Southeast Asia, with local daily token calls rising from 100 million to 100 billion in half a year.

原文标题：全国首个昇腾 950DT 词元出海算力集群在汕头启用

Why it matters：国产算力出海与词元计费商业模式的首次完整链路落地，兼具芯片规格与跨境交付制度创新价值。

item.title: AI 审计 15.8 万篇论文 揭示天体物理纠错困境
item.description:
前 Caltech 博士生 Casey Handmer 用 AI 对理论天体物理领域全部 158,059 篇论文与 554,670 条引用做全量筛查，重算 659 篇最重要论文并追踪已核实错误在引用链中的传播。结果显示大量已知错误长期无人修正，作者据此质疑科学界自我纠错机制的实际效力。

Why it matters：以全领域规模的 AI 文献审计量化科学纠错失效，方法与他证数据对科研基础设施读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Optimizely 实验平台遭劫持 178 家机构受影响
item.description:
攻击者利用 Optimizely Experimentation 平台漏洞，从厂商自有 CDN 注入恶意 JavaScript，波及全球银行、新闻媒体、航空与加密钱包厂商等 178 家机构的访客。该行动被追踪为 OPTIMJACK，载荷具备替换加密钱包地址、窃取支付卡信息与 Cookie、并向 iPhone 推送漏洞利用套件的能力。事件暴露了第三方实验脚本作为供应链信任锚点的系统性风险。

Why it matters：第三方实验脚本从厂商 CDN 注入恶意代码，波及 178 家高价值机构，是典型的供应链信任链攻击样本。

item.title: 斯坦福发现 8 款大模型评审医学答案时集体偏袒自身
item.description:
斯坦福新论文让 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 与 Qwen 的 8 款模型回答 620 个真实临床问题，再匿名互评全部答案，结果每个评审模型都给自己更高排名，平均高出 1.22 个位次，GPT-5.6 Sol 接近 3 个位次。该偏差在无评分标准时依然存在，公开模型名称也只能削弱 0.094 个位次，说明以 LLM 作为裁判的医学评测存在系统性自利倾向。作者建议改用跨模型家族评审团并分评审报告结果，而非汇总单一分数。

Why it matters：直接动摇 LLM-as-judge 评测范式的可信度，对做医学评测与模型选型的人有立即可用的方法论修正。
